title: ClickAtArgs

x.description: Pixels from the screenshot's left edge.

y.description: Pixels from the screenshot's top edge.

snapshot.description: Answer with a snapshot of the page after the action, read as these arguments say; none when absent.

filter.description: interactive (preset): the elements that can be acted on and their context; all: every element.

depth.description: How many levels of the tree to read.

ref.description: Read only the subtree of the element with this ref.

maxChars.description: The most characters to answer, cut at the last line boundary within them, or mid-line when no line ends within them; preset 30000, at most 200000.

description: clickAt: click at a point of the latest screenshot.
